info.title: Message Vault HTTP API
info.description: HTTP API for a local Message Vault. Bearer session tokens come from login. API tokens come from Settings → Account and can import and export only. Register and login exist when VAULT_AUTH is local (the default). POST /v1/auth/hanko/session exists for Hanko sign-in.

get.description:
# Errors

Returns an API error when the caller is not a signed-in session or the list
cannot be loaded.

post.description:
# Errors

Returns an API error when the caller is not a signed-in session, the label
is invalid, or the insert fails.

delete.description:
# Errors

Returns an API error when the caller is not a signed-in session or the token
is missing.

patch.description:
# Errors

Returns an API error when the caller is not a signed-in session, the label
is invalid, or the token is missing.

post.summary:
`POST /v1/account/delete-messages` — delete conversations, messages, and
attachments; keep contacts and account login.
post.description:
# Errors

Returns an API error when confirmation is missing, the caller is not a
signed-in session, or the delete fails.

get.description:
# Errors

Returns an API error when the caller is not a signed-in session or the
profile cannot be loaded.

post.description:
# Errors

Returns an API error when the caller is not a signed-in session, a handle
service is unsupported, or the update fails.

get.summary: Download a previously stored content-addressed asset (read-only).

head.summary: Probe whether a content-addressed asset is already stored (no body).

post.summary: `POST /v1/auth/change-password` — verify the current password, set a new one.

`POST /v1/auth/hanko/session` — check a Hanko session JSON Web Token and
return a vault API token.
`POST /v1/auth/login` — authenticate with username + password, return an API token.

get.summary:
Returns the server's configured authentication mode so clients
can render the correct login form before authenticating.

post.summary: `POST /v1/auth/register` — create an account and return an API token.
`POST /v1/auth/try-demo` — self-hosted demo session, or a private guest copy.

requestBody.description: message-ir JSONL. application/x-ndjson, application/jsonl, and multipart/form-data (field jsonl plus file parts) are accepted.

is_demo.description: True for the seeded demo account (cannot be deleted).

is_guest.description: True when `accounts.guest_status` is set (ready or assigned sample copy).

handles.description: Handles to add/link onto the account profile.

remove_handles.description: Handles to unlink from the account profile.

token.description: Replacement session token after password change (previous sessions are revoked).

last_modified.description: When the contact’s address-book shape last changed (`datetime('now')`).

ContactMutationBody.description: Body for `POST /v1/export/contacts/{id}`. Exactly one mutation field should be set.

ContactSelectionSummary.description: Contact-level first/last seen and message counts for the selection table.

handles.description: Normalized (and raw when distinct) handle values for client-side filter.

last_modified.description: When the contact’s address-book shape last changed (`datetime('now')`).

name_alias.description: Per service+identity alias from `contact_handles` when linked.

id.description: Numeric `conversations.id`, serialized as a string for `in:<id>` queries.

expires_in_days.description: Days until expiry. Omit for the default (365 days). Pass `0` for no expiry.

token.description: Plaintext secret — returned once at creation.

token_hint.description: Masked form for the Settings list (also persisted).

current_password.description: Required when the account has a local password.

attachments.description: Unique attachment fingerprints among matching messages.

conversations.description: Distinct conversations with at least one matching message.

total_bytes.description: Sum of known `size_bytes` for those unique fingerprints (unknown sizes omitted).

hanko_jwt.description:
The raw Hanko session JSON Web Token from the client-side
`onSessionCreated` callback.

phones_needing_review.description: Flagged phone handles (ambiguous; review note set) inserted by this import.

chat_identifier.description: Raw text of the conversation's chat handle (via `handles`).
